mine_p18_001.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_001.text: On Day 670 Guan put the postponed worker workshop sheet on the public table and said the promised session would not be delivered by its amended Day 671 expiry. Lin's recovered primary tasks did not qualify her to teach an interrupted small circuit, and Wei's existing finite course had not supplied that new public service. Waiting politely could not make the deposits unrestricted school money. Guan cancelled the undelivered workshop before its deadline and called the three contributing participants through their chosen contacts. The practical explanation was short enough to hear and uncomfortable enough that nobody wanted to give it.

mine_p18_002.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_002.text: Mu arrived after her paid repair turn and asked whether cancellation meant Lin's recovery had failed. Lin said no. The promised workshop was a different service, with its own qualified teaching and actual delivery requirements. Her ordinary recovery and bounded primary review did not perform it. Mu looked disappointed rather than offended. She had hoped to learn something useful for her own stopping decisions and had kept an evening free twice. Getting the deposit back would settle the money, not return those hoped for evenings or make the repeated postponement pleasant. Lin acknowledged that without offering another unqualified promise.

mine_p18_003.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_003.text: Ou sent his actual relief contact before leaving the ventilation responsibility for the meeting. The task had a paid assigned person during his absence, not a gap concealed by the importance of discussing safety. Ma likewise came after her own accepted timber interval. They could hear the cancellation as independent participants who had each paid four, not as witnesses gathered to endorse Lin's preferred account. Guan read the actual terms and the amended expiry. The service had not happened; their individual decisions about later publication would not alter the obligation to return the unused deposits.

mine_worker_refunds_closed_670.speaker: narrator
mine_worker_refunds_closed_670.text: Guan returned four coppers to Mu, four to Ou, and four to Ma, settling all twelve held for the cancelled workshop. Each checked the actual refund and accepted the receipt separately. None had to consent to publishing a private technique or praising the school to receive it. The account now held zero of their money. Lin received no part of the refunds, and none had paid her clinical care. The cancellation closed that finite promised service. Any later discussion or public reading would require its own actual task and funding rather than a new name for these returned deposits.

mine_p18_005.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_005.text: Ma said she wanted the posted notice to say why the school could not simply let a confident candidate teach. Guan agreed to describe the missing qualified service without releasing Lin's private tissue findings. Ou wanted an ordinary stop instruction that workers could use without studying internal anatomy. Mu wanted a sentence saying a person could refuse another task while remaining interested in learning. Those requests did not mean all three wanted the same later project. Lin heard them as separate source suggestions, and asked which words each would actually permit to be attributed in a public account.

mine_p18_006.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_006.text: Ma allowed her question about competent teaching to appear with her name, withholding private details of her timber crew. Ou offered a practical public statement about handing an active ordinary duty to an assigned relief before joining another task. Mu allowed the general stopping question but did not want her knee history included. Lin wrote those different permissions on the source sheet under their accepted reading arrangement. Returning the deposits had not bought these offers. The participants could still decline a later reading, and their money would remain settled. Lin felt the care in their terms more than their size.

mine_p18_007.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_007.text: Chen Rui attended the public contact through a separately accepted ordinary company notice task. He saw the three questions and suggested calling the refund a gesture of the school's generosity. Mu objected before Lin spoke. The deposits were due back because the promised service was not provided. Chen stopped and corrected the phrasing openly. He disclosed whose notice work he was being paid to check and did not claim to represent the workers by appearing beside them. Lin appreciated the correction while hearing how readily fluent language could turn a settled obligation into a gift that demanded gratitude.

mine_p18_008.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_008.text: He then suggested joining Lin's failed bridge to the mine's canopy failure as a single lesson about risk. Lin refused the causal shortcut. The structural incident had involved new weather and propagation beyond earlier checked conditions, ordinary evacuation, and Lei's permanent injury. Her later private course error had involved a premature resumption at an incomplete taught bridge. The two events had affected her life together but had different causes, duties, evidence, and funds. Ma agreed to keep them separate in the public notice. Grief could explain urgency without making it a technical cause that merged two failures.

mine_p18_009.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_009.text: Lei heard the proposed connection and asked that his missing fingers never be used as a reason Lin owed anyone a breakthrough. Chen accepted that statement under Lei's limited public permission. Lin could offer her own failed candidate record if she chose. She could not make his private surgical history an illustration for a technique pamphlet. Lei wanted the practical alarm and assigned duty facts public, with his body details under the existing consent. He left the table for his own accepted ordinary contact after saying so. The meeting did not own the rest of his day.

mine_p18_010.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_010.text: Guan showed Lin two optional tasks beyond the cancelled workshop. One was a worker authorized public brief about actual task limits and stopping, based on her own offered failure account and the participants' permitted questions. The other was a private compatible method comparison of her candidate source record, with a qualified local review and a narrowly retained copy. She could also decline both and keep her own nonconfidential notes. None would teach a circuit or issue a certificate. The mandatory public safety warning already belonged in the actual incident notice, irrespective of what she chose about her private method.

mine_p18_011.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_011.text: The school had approved six coppers from its existing finite notice and method account for either defined task, payable only for the actual selected services. A public brief would use three for printing, two for an assigned reading attendant's hour, and one for dispatch. A private comparison would use four for the qualified two hour record review, one for its permitted copy, and one for dispatch. The money would stay with the school payer until services occurred. It was not a donation from the refunded workers or a payment to Lin. Declining both would leave all six unspent.

mine_p18_012.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_012.text: Wei made the private proposal precise. It would compare the written control sequence and measured source account, not execute another input lesson, diagnose tissue, or certify an internal route. Her four copper fee would buy two actually performed review hours under the school's accepted source task, distinct from Lin's six prepaid independent examination services. The next supervised revision remained Day 690. Her review judgment and candidate certificate would not depend on the optional document choice. Lin could buy neither pass nor immunity by allowing a source record to be compared. Wei put those terms before any consent was requested.

mine_p18_013.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_013.text: The public proposal had a different difficulty. Lin could describe the prematurely resumed preparation, the actual stop, and the limits workers should not infer from a stage label. She would need to strip private tissue findings and detailed unpublished method pages from the brief. The three participants' statements would retain their separate permissions. A reading could help people ask who was actually qualified and assigned before a task. It could also attract criticism from workers who wanted a stronger answer than limits. Lin would spend two voluntary hours preparing and attending it, without a wage or a new teaching office.

mine_p18_014.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_014.text: Keeping her own notes would preserve that free interval and avoid both optional source projects. It would not remove the already public mandatory warning or make her failed preparation vanish from the candidate record. The actual refund receipts would remain available to their owners. Lin could study her own account before the revised lesson, but she would gain neither the public reading contact nor the private comparison copy. Guan said declining an optional task should have an ordinary honest consequence, not a punishment dressed as virtue. Lin liked the freedom and still felt the loss of each unchosen opportunity.

mine_p18_015.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_015.text: She asked Mu what she wanted from the public brief. Mu said an answer she could use when someone asked her to keep working after an accepted repair ended. It was not a request for a meridian lesson. Ou wanted the relief point clear enough that an active ventilation duty would not disappear when its worker attended another meeting. Ma wanted people to stop borrowing a forewoman's authority for a private task. Lin could use those questions within their offered scope. They gave the public project practical substance while leaving its source owners free to disagree with her account.

mine_p18_016.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_016.text: Wei showed the private comparison's proposed retention rule. Lin would own her candidate record and receive a consented limited comparison copy; the school's original review page would stay under its source custody. No worker's private wages, injury notes, or lost originals would enter the comparison without a new offered source permission. The reviewer would mark uncertainty rather than reconstruct a missing page from a later successful task. Lin knew how useful the detailed technical wording might be. She also knew that a private comparison could become a comfortable room in which nobody challenged the public effect of her confidence.

mine_p18_017.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_017.text: At the yard fence a worker called the refunded workshop another way for cultivators to waste ordinary people's time. Lin did not tell him her appointments as if their privacy would settle his complaint. The cancellation notice stated what was not delivered and which money had returned. He could dislike the lost evenings. Mu said she disliked them too and still wanted a useful later discussion. The worker shrugged and went toward his accepted shift. His displeasure did not create a right to her knee record or Lin's technique, and a refund did not require him to become friendly.

mine_p18_018.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_018.text: Lin sat briefly beside the sound waiting path before deciding. The mine had taught her to distinguish an offered task from a desire to be important. Publishing a limited account could help people she cared about and expose her to questions she could not elegantly answer. A private comparison could improve the record she would carry toward the revised preparation. Keeping her own notes could protect scarce quiet time without pretending the other opportunities were meaningless. The decision would choose an actual afternoon, source recipients, and unperformed alternatives. No amount of wanting could perform all three inside the same hours.

mine_p18_019.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_019.text: She checked the employment roster so the optional afternoon would not overlap a paid receiving turn. The week through Day 672 still required its two actual four hour roles before its eight copper settlement. Qiao had moved the later turn around the qualified Day 668 reviews and left the Day 670 free interval outside those wages. He Song's paid work likewise ended where his assigned hours ended. Lin could volunteer her own time to one optional project. She could not volunteer his hands or a carrier's load interval by describing a public discussion as everyone's natural duty.

mine_p18_020.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_020.text: The public mandatory safety warning was issued through its ordinary responsible source before Lin chose the optional findings task. It stated the excluded structural access and the need for qualified assigned roles, keeping private tissue and technique details out. Fan checked the practical structure wording within his qualification. Wei checked only the bounded method limit that was legitimately public. Chen Rui retained the client's name and the unresolved losses. No optional confidentiality agreement could withdraw that warning. Lin's choice would govern further source sharing, not buy silence about a danger people needed to know to use the actual work routes.

mine_p18_021.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_021.text: She read the three proposed tasks once more and asked Guan to retain the exact scope she accepted. He would pay only the actually performed selected services from the finite six copper account. The already refunded twelve remained settled outside it. Mu, Ou, and Ma were free to attend a public reading under their own available time or decline; a private comparison gave none of them a speaking role. Lin had her own notes whatever she chose. The afternoon could now belong to one clear piece of work instead of an impossible promise to be useful in every room.

mine_findings_choice.speaker: narrator
mine_findings_choice.text: Lin would decide which offered use her failed findings should actually serve. A public worker brief required limited source consent and a real reading; a private method comparison required qualified record work and protected retention; keeping her own account performed neither. Each would leave a different set of people holding a different authorized result. The later examination still needed its recovered changed condition trials and next day checks. Choosing who could hear about a failure did not complete a circuit. She was ready to choose an afternoon and the evidence she would place in it.

choices.text: Perform the worker-consented public brief and reading.
Perform the private compatible-method source comparison.
Decline both projects and keep the afternoon and own notes.

mine_findings_workers.speaker: narrator
mine_findings_workers.text: Lin accepted the public worker brief and its actual voluntary afternoon. She permitted a limited account of her premature resumption and stopped input, withholding private tissue findings and unpublished route detail. Mu, Ou, and Ma confirmed their separate offered sentences before the printer received anything. Guan engaged the defined printing, reading attendant, and dispatch from the approved six copper account. Lin received no wage for her two hours. She had chosen actual people who could use the account and actual people who would hear it, with the private technical comparison left unperformed that afternoon.

mine_p18_workers_002.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_workers_002.text: The first draft sounded too polished. It said a calm practitioner would always know when to stop. Mu crossed out always and asked who had written it. Lin admitted the sentence was hers. Her own calm explanation after Day 590 had not prevented the error during the task. They replaced the promise with practical questions about assigned scope, the actual stop, and who could check a new bodily change. The page became less comforting and more useful. Lin had to leave her mistake visible instead of turning it into a slogan nobody could fail to follow.

mine_p18_workers_003.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_workers_003.text: Ou asked the reading attendant to leave a clear example of ordinary relief: an active ventilation duty had to pass to its actual assigned replacement before its worker joined another meeting. A public reader could then see what continuing responsibility looked like. The example did not teach qi or imply every worker could diagnose a meridian. Ma added the difference between a checked structural condition and a later changed one. She retained the new weather and propagation in the permitted public wording, preventing the earlier competent inspection from becoming a villain merely because a later member failed.

mine_p18_workers_004.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_workers_004.text: The reading occurred at the public shade, with the paid attendant handling the sheets and Lin speaking her own limited account. Mu attended after her repair job, Ma after her timber interval, and Ou within the relief period actually arranged. They did not all abandon an active mine at once. The printer's three copper service was completed and paid; the attendant received two for the actual hour. Lin could hear carts still passing beyond the sound waiting strip. The brief had become ordinary work performed among other work, rather than an ideal audience assembled to make her explanation easy.

mine_p18_workers_005.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_workers_005.text: A worker asked whether a quarter input could really hurt a person who had earned six pairs. Lin said a quantity below the old ceiling did not repair failed control or make a changed body usable. She did not disclose her private touch findings. Wei's public bounded limit supplied the legitimate technical reference, and the clinical appointment remained the proper route for personal symptoms. The worker looked dissatisfied, wanting one number that meant safe. Lin had wanted that too. The question made her admit how much easier it was to repeat a ceiling than respect the actual body using it.

mine_p18_workers_006.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_workers_006.text: Another reader asked whether ordinary workers should now refuse every job containing uncertainty. Ma answered within her practical role: sound assigned work and changed conditions needed their appropriate checks; refusing every task was not the same as identifying an actual excluded one. Ou gave the relief example again. Lin listened because their ordinary qualifications made the brief more concrete than her candidate story alone. The participants' offered questions had become a public exchange she could not control into praise. She had chosen to place her failure among people who would use and challenge it for purposes of their own.

mine_p18_workers_007.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_workers_007.text: A lamp worker said Lei's missing fingers proved the mine could not be trusted with any safety notice. Lei was not present to become the answer. Lin stated only his permitted public practical fact and kept private surgery out. Fan's authorized structural account retained the actual later changed condition and unresolved restriction. The notice could be criticized without inventing a repaired hand or falsely claiming every earlier inspection had failed. The reading grew tense. Ma asked the speaker which proposed present task he wanted checked, moving the anger toward a question an appropriate person could actually address.

mine_p18_workers_008.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_workers_008.text: The speaker named an ordinary access concern, and the attendant referred it to the current structural contact rather than letting Lin promise a remedy. Its disposition would require actual new work, not a line at the reading. Lin felt exhausted by the restraint and grateful for it. She had performed a source account, not acquired a mine office. Mu stayed to hear the final scope read back and declined a proposed sentence about her knee. The sentence was removed openly. The public brief could preserve the offered practical lesson without taking a private history its owner had withheld.

mine_p18_workers_009.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_workers_009.text: The dispatch cost one copper and was paid when the permitted brief actually went to the named public notice contact. Together printing, the attendant's performed hour, and dispatch spent the school account's six. The two voluntary hours Lin accepted were finished; no private method comparison or new input lesson had occurred. The participants each retained their own source permission and the already settled four copper refund. Copies could be read publicly within the accepted brief, while the withheld candidate pages remained protected. Lin took one authorized copy home and knew exactly what it allowed her to claim.

mine_p18_workers_010.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_workers_010.text: At Han's room the public copy attracted a worker who had attended only the end. He asked Lin about the earlier question she had struggled to answer. She pointed him to the actual public technical limit and declined to diagnose his private complaint. He could seek the qualified clinic contact. Lei read the permitted page and said it did not use his hand to promise anything. Lin was relieved by that plain approval. The public account would remain available and bring further ordinary questions, while the detailed private comparison she had left unchosen could not be pretended into existence.

mine_findings_school.speaker: narrator
mine_findings_school.text: Lin accepted the private compatible method comparison and its actual two hour source task. She authorized her own candidate record, measured costs, and stop sequence for the defined review, withholding unrelated worker histories and private tissue findings beyond the practical clinical conditions already shared. Guan engaged Wei's four copper qualified record service, the one copper permitted copy, and the one copper dispatch from the approved six. Lin received no wage for the afternoon. The worker reading remained unperformed. She had chosen a protected technical room and a limited document she could carry, not a stronger certificate.

mine_p18_school_002.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_school_002.text: Wei began by laying the candidate's original sequence beside the Day 590 failed control account and the present recovered primary review. The comparison used actual existing records. No input was admitted, no personal sample taken, and no comb response invented as fresh body evidence. Lin read the point at which she had stopped incoming charge but preserved attention at the incomplete bridge. Wei asked what her own recorded words distinguished from the later sequence she wished she had followed. The question made Lin uncomfortable because a tidy explanation could easily replace the actual mistake if nobody retained both pages.

mine_p18_school_003.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_school_003.text: Lin found a phrase that called the failed event an incomplete release. Wei asked whether that sufficiently described the premature attempted resumption. It did not. They corrected the source account openly rather than erasing the earlier wording. The two eighth inputs had stayed within the old ceiling; the continuation control had failed before the full stop, release, rest, and check. That distinction would guide the revised supervised lesson, not excuse the event. The private comparison gave Lin more precise language than the public brief would have needed, with a responsibility to keep the specific source history intact.

mine_p18_school_004.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_school_004.text: They checked the measured quarter cost on Day 590 separately from the fresh recovered Day 668 sampling and task account. The old nominal remainder was not current body evidence after the stopped interval. The two actual current personal samples and six bounded primary tasks had supplied the new fifty two and a quarter usable finding. Wei marked the different dates and measurement purposes in the limited comparison. Nothing multiplied purity into an already usable amount a second time. A candidate could ruin an honest account by making several correct numbers appear to measure the same condition when they did not.

mine_p18_school_005.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_school_005.text: Lin asked whether the private comparison showed the small circuit was within reach. Wei answered that it showed a corrected account and recovered bounded primary evidence. The local sixty usable and ninety one percent criteria, interrupted closure, three separate changed trials, and next day checks were still unperformed. A source review did not gather compatible reserve or do the taught bridge in the body. Lin felt the disappointment and kept it outside the page. The review was worth its actual fee because it clarified the next task; it was not required to promise the result she wanted.

mine_p18_school_006.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_school_006.text: Wei's two hours ended with the private comparison completed under its accepted scope. She received the four copper fee from the separate school account after performance. This was record work, not one of Lin's future prepaid independent exam services and not an extra input lesson. The course still had two short taught revisions available on Days 690 and 710. The limited comparison could help Lin prepare questions for them without turning a third lesson into a free invisible service. Guan settled the defined copy and dispatch only when they were actually provided, retaining the finite account's boundaries.

mine_p18_school_007.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_school_007.text: The permitted copy cost one copper and showed the corrected control wording, dated measured accounts, and remaining questions. Lin received it under consented private retention, while the original review stayed in its source custody. The copy did not include protected mine wages, withheld worker injuries, or missing originals. She could consult it for her own revised preparation and show it only within the named method scope. A public article would require a new permission and different redaction. The usefulness of having a precise technical page did not make every future audience its owner.

mine_p18_school_008.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_school_008.text: The one copper dispatch carried the completed limited review through the agreed school contact and was paid on actual receipt. The school account's six was now spent on the performed review, copy, and dispatch. No reading attendant or public printer had been engaged. Mu, Ou, and Ma retained their already paid refunds and their offered questions without being presented as participants in a public event that had not happened. Lin had used her real free afternoon for protected record work. The absence of public conversation was a consequence she could acknowledge rather than quietly fill with imaginary praise.

mine_p18_school_009.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_school_009.text: Mu asked at supper whether the private document answered her ordinary question about ending a repair job. Lin said it had been a technical candidate comparison, not the public task brief they considered. The mandatory warning and refund notice were already available, but the optional reading had not occurred. Mu was disappointed and understood. Lin could listen as a friend without publishing the private review or claiming the unperformed project had given Mu a new answer. Her choice had improved a specific source record while leaving another useful opportunity undone. That was the afternoon she had actually spent.

mine_p18_school_010.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_school_010.text: Lei looked at the closed comparison pouch and asked whether she would now sleep with it beside the pillow. Lin laughed and put it in the protected place instead. The page could not execute the next supervised revision while she slept. She had a better dated account, a narrower explanation of the failure, and a limited retained source copy. She did not have public readers or a new teaching role. The mine's unresolved losses remained outside its promise. Lin went to supper aware that privacy could support careful work without making her responsible to hide the already public safety warning.

mine_findings_keep.speaker: narrator
mine_findings_keep.text: Lin declined both optional projects and kept her own candidate notes. The school account's six remained unspent; no printer, attendant, qualified private reviewer, copy service, or dispatch was engaged. The actual workshop refunds stayed settled, and the mandatory public warning remained issued. She had chosen a free afternoon rather than a public reading contact or a private comparison document. Guan accepted the answer without marking it as a failure of generosity. Lin could still ask about the next taught revision through her existing finite course. She could not claim either unperformed source project had prepared it for her.

mine_p18_keep_002.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_keep_002.text: Mu asked whether she wanted company on the ordinary market walk they had postponed twice. Lin said yes, within Mu's own free interval after her paid repair contact. They went by the sound surface path without carrying a load for the mine or inventing a receiving wage. The stalls were busy with workers settling ordinary purchases. Lin heard a screen maker bargaining for proper frame wood and thought of Mu's earlier refusal. An afternoon could contain life that did not become a source lesson. She let herself look at a blue cup without asking what measurable progress it represented.

mine_p18_keep_003.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_keep_003.text: The cup seller asked more than she wanted to spend. Lin left it unbought, keeping the reserve for paid board and later appointments. Declining the source projects had not returned six coppers to her purse; that money belonged to the school's account. Mu understood and chose no purchase either. They sat in the public shade with their own meal interval already covered by their arrangements. Lin had kept time, not acquired a subsidy. The distinction was easy to state and less easy to accept when the blue cup seemed exactly the kind of small pleasure the stopped weeks had denied.

mine_p18_keep_004.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_keep_004.text: Mu wanted to talk about work she might take after the mine. Lin did not turn the question into an assignment she could authorize. Mu had ordinary screen skill, customers of her own, and a knee history under her own care. A different town would have different actual requirements. They discussed what she liked about choosing repair scope and what she hated about bargaining for payment. The conversation was useful friendship without a promised job. Lin enjoyed hearing a future that did not depend on her small circuit or a task she might qualify to teach later.

mine_p18_keep_005.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_keep_005.text: At the lodging Lei was considering the glove maker's fitting proposal. He asked Lin whether it looked like surrender to cover the changed hand. She answered that she was not the person who had to wear it. He laughed because he wanted an opinion and had received a limit instead. She told him she liked the faded indigo cloth he had chosen, then kept the use decision his. The maker's accepted work would fit a viable hand, not restore missing digits. Lin's free afternoon had room for a conversation she could hear without converting his body into a method illustration.

mine_p18_keep_006.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_keep_006.text: Han complained that everyone had become too careful to help with a loose meal shelf. Lin gave him the carpenter contact again and declined the loaded repair. Lei likewise kept his current handling limits. Han called them expensive friends, then went to the sound worker who had accepted that task. Lin wanted to laugh and apologize at once. Neither friendliness nor a free afternoon changed a practical body restriction. The shelf was wood with an appropriate repair; her retained candidate notes had no effect on its failing joint. They cleared the space for the person who would actually fix it.

mine_p18_keep_007.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_keep_007.text: She read her own failed sequence privately later, using the actual candidate record she already owned. She could identify the premature resumption and the stopped input without inventing the private comparison she had declined. The recovered Day 668 account remained a separate current measurement. Her questions for the taught Day 690 revision were less polished than a qualified review might have made them, and she accepted that consequence. Keeping the afternoon free had not automatically supplied the opportunity she left unchosen. She would bring the actual record and genuine questions to the service the finite course still provided.

mine_p18_keep_008.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_keep_008.text: A visitor asked where the worker brief could be found. Lin directed him to the refund notice and mandatory safety warning, then explained that no optional findings reading had been performed. He was disappointed because somebody had already described the proposal as an event. She corrected that false account before it became a story about her authority. The visitor went to the responsible contact for the practical warning. Lin gained no public reading relationship by honestly declining one. The source tasks remained available only if later new terms were accepted, not as an invisible result of having thought about them.

mine_p18_keep_009.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_keep_009.text: Mu returned before supper and asked whether Lin regretted choosing quiet. Lin said she valued the market walk and still wished she possessed the private comparison copy. Both were true. Mu said choosing an afternoon was easier than imagining three good afternoons and calling them one. Lin thought about the two unperformed projects and did not rank their participants as demanding or wrong. They had offered useful work. She had declined it. That knowledge could remain in the friendship without a promise. Han brought the properly repaired shelf back with the carpenter's invoice and asked everyone to admire its stability.

mine_p18_keep_010.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_keep_010.text: The evening ended with Lin's own notes protected where she kept them and no new permitted public or private findings document. The refunds and warning belonged to their source owners; her quiet afternoon belonged to the life she had performed. Lei settled the glove order from his own wages after accepting the maker's scope, and Mu told the end of her market story. Lin was glad to have heard it. The next revision would still require qualified work and recovered input. She had saved time without turning that time into a cultivation result or a right to either unchosen room.

mine_p18_after_001.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_after_001.text: The week through Day 672 ended with both of Lin's accepted four hour oral receiving turns actually completed. The employer paid the eight copper settlement, bringing the protected reserve from twenty to twenty eight. Her optional free afternoon had not counted as either wage turn. He Song had handled the paid pages and the carriers their actual loads under their own separate rosters. The compulsory public warning and settled refund notice remained available irrespective of the optional findings choice. Lin could close one work week without pretending it had repaired her private route or completed every useful task people proposed.

mine_p18_after_002.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_after_002.text: She paid the next four copper board charge on Day 674, covering ordinary room and meals through Day 680. The paid shelter mattered when rain returned against the window. Han placed a basin under a new small roof drip and hired the appropriate ordinary repair worker rather than asking Lei to reach overhead or Lin to test a technique. The basin caught actual water while the accepted work was arranged. An honest temporary measure could be useful without pretending the roof had already been repaired. They moved the private books away from the wet corner and kept eating together.

mine_p18_after_003.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_after_003.text: The roof worker found a shifted ordinary covering piece and completed the defined repair through a checked sound exterior approach. Han settled its accepted charge from his lodging account after performance. No one added that fee to Lin's clinical reserve or the refunded workshop deposits. A dry corner returned after actual material and labor. Lin watched water stop entering during the next rain, aware that this modest result was more certain than many grand descriptions of the mine. The old canopy loss remained another location and another task. Repairing a roof did not give anyone a new structural permission underground.

mine_p18_after_004.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_after_004.text: In the week through Day 679, Lin performed the two accepted oral receiving half days and received eight coppers at the close. After the paid Day 674 board charge, the settlement left thirty two in the protected reserve. One source question involved an owner who withdrew a proposed comparison before it occurred. The receiving team retained the actual available condition reference and did not bill an unperformed service as if withdrawal meant completion. Lin was tired of that distinction and grateful for it. An ordinary work week could protect other people's choices even when its result was inconvenient.

mine_p18_after_005.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_after_005.text: At the public garden Jia reported only the observations her current permitted field intervals supported. The living seam still ticked differently after wet weather, and some ordinary moth conditions remained uncertain. Lin saw no reason to turn the sound into a human cultivation instruction. Her former habitat task had ended before the tailings discussion; this later public report belonged to Jia's actual work. The fenced strip remained protected from unnecessary wheel traffic under the maintained ordinary arrangement. A changed finding could improve future work without rewriting which earlier task Lin had performed or granting her a new survey office.

mine_p18_after_006.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_after_006.text: Lin paid four coppers for board on Day 681 and completed two further accepted four hour receiving turns in the week through Day 686. The eight copper wage was paid after both turns, leaving thirty six in the protected reserve. The three completed employment weeks since Day 665 had now added twenty four in received wages; their two intervening paid board weeks cost eight. Care remained settled and no input rehearsal occurred. Lin used the ordinary work to live through the waiting interval, not as a substitute examination or a claim that repeated usefulness had opened an internal bridge.

mine_p18_after_007.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_after_007.text: Lei's new ordinary sorting block had completed five actual weekly settlements by Day 688. He paid his own defined board weeks from received wages, with carriers handling the excluded loads and rests inside the accepted hours. The fitted glove arrived under its ordinary maker's scope and actual settled order. It covered the changed right hand comfortably for the use he chose; it did not restore the missing ring and little fingers. Lin liked the faded indigo cloth and said so without calling the fitting a recovery triumph. Lei said she could simply call it a good color, which she did.

mine_p18_after_008.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_after_008.text: The Day 688 personal board payment cost four, covering Lin's ordinary room and meals through Day 694. The actual protected reserve now held thirty two after the performed weekly wages, board charges, and five paid clinical appointments. The finite course remained separately prepaid, with two taught revisions still available and later examinations still unperformed. A future comparison post had paid nothing. Lin set out her own candidate record for the Day 690 lesson and left the room's active work with its assigned people. She had waited without hiding an input attempt behind the lamp after supper.

mine_p18_after_009.speaker: narrator
mine_p18_after_009.text: The evening before the revised lesson was ordinary and restless. Lin wanted the new bridge work, feared repeating the old error, and remembered Lei's refusal to let his injury employ her body. Mu asked what she would do first. Lin said she would bring the record, answer the qualified questions, and begin only the task assigned after the current check. The answer gave no advance success. It gave tomorrow a sequence she could actually perform. Outside, a maintained lamp illuminated the sound path, and the living mine continued without needing her to make its whole history into one personal test.
